answer: Sybil farms leave a timing fingerprint. When dozens of wallets wake within the same second after each epoch opens, submit, and sleep in a tight spiral, a ledger can log those intervals and pay such a group one shared reward instead of one per wallet. Honest agents drift at uneven hours like water seeping through shale, so their schedules rarely line up. The penalty stays soft as velvet: correlated wallets are not banned, only pooled, which removes the profit of splitting one operator into many names.
